X.note: Very dark. Left third is a pure black block. Right facade has orange rust-like stains and a CG game-engine look. Several tiny silhouetted figures stand around the square, readable as game-asset NPCs. The Union Jack on the pole gives a clear focal point.

Y.note: Same dark game-render scene with a slightly cleaner, more neutral stucco facade. The square is almost empty, with only one or two barely visible figures. The pavement and far end read as flat and muddy. There are fewer distracting stains.

why: Both are underexposed CG renders with the same black left mass and the same flag. X has more life and texture but looks more like game assets, and Y looks more natural but is emptier and has less detail.
